movingCeiling.metric: disclosure-debt: canonical-JSON byte count of the FULL-mode ATTESTATION disclosure bundle that satisfies the frozen census (census/requirements.json) against the seeded reference vault; lower is better.

open.statement: Reduce the FULL bundle below 2049 canonical bytes without dropping any of the 23 census requirements — first through field-pruning (omit bundle fields no requirement reads) and predicate-coarsening (weakest form the census still accepts, e.g. count>=90 instead of exact 142).

objective.metric: disclosure-debt: canonical-JSON byte count of the FULL-mode ATTESTATION disclosure bundle that satisfies the frozen census (census/requirements.json) against the seeded reference vault; lower is better.
objective.gate: 8 held-out requirement-ids drawn by the Gap from census/requirements.json, each checked by `node scripts/check-requirement.mjs <id> <bundle>` exactly as a relying party would. 8/8 or the round is zero.
objective.hardConstraint: the candidate bundle is produced through the workshop actor's live Ruleset chain (a bundle assembled around the Warden is not a result at any size), and it verifies offline against issuer DIDs via the local Gatekeeper.

note: A projection of runtime state for the model instruments (/star · game42 · spellweb). The run directory and frontier.json are authoritative; wiring a consumer is the First Person’s (T6).
